# testdata

This directory contains assets used in developer environments and in automated tests.

| **File**                      | **Purpose**                                                                                                                                           |
| ----------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| testing_dwh.\*.ddl            | Customizes the DDL used when loading the testing data warehouse into a database.                                                                      |
| testing_dwh.csv.zst           | Testing DWH containing data used in tests and local development.                                                                                      |
| wide_dwh.\*.ddl               | DDL for the wide (500-column) testing data warehouse (generated by generate_wide_dwh.py).                                                             |
| wide_dwh.csv.zst              | Wide DWH (500 columns, 1K rows) for testing UI behavior with many columns (generated by generate_wide_dwh.py).                                        |
| clustered_dwh.\*.ddl          | DDL for loading clustered data into the testing data warehouse (see generate_clustered_dwh.py).                                                       |
| clustered_dwh.csv.zst         | Clustered dataset for testing stats logic in cluster experiment designs (see generate_clustered_dwh.py).                                              |
| project_wellbeing_dwh.\*.ddl  | DDL for the Project Wellbeing demo warehouse (generated by generate_project_wellbeing_dwh.py).                                                        |
| project_wellbeing_dwh.csv.zst | Project Wellbeing demo warehouse (6K synthetic students, 120 schools) backing the demo organization (generated by generate_project_wellbeing_dwh.py). |
